assertion_analysis.condition_to_fail: A supersede in the authority fails to retire its target, so the live unchained_holder count stays above before-minus-targets; falsify.log:3 demonstrates exactly this reddening.
A mutation applies without leaving a StandardNameChange carrying the authority file sha, so a target has no receipt.
The campaign moves any other population (dropped_edge, never_bound, derived_parent, orphan_awaiting_retirement) between the stored cohort read and the read-back.
A target survives with a name_stage/status pair other than superseded/superseded.
None can be named: the filter compares status to lower-case "running" while the graph returns "Running" (quiet-before-apply.log:110), so quiet is true whatever the graph holds.
An admitted predecessor still binds a live StandardNameSource, or the successor lacks a path the predecessor's record names.
The planted different-quantity pair is answered same-quantity above both floors, so the floor admits it and the mode exits non-zero.

findings.text: blocking: the quiet-graph filter compares the transaction status to "running" while Neo4j returns "Running" — the same log's own entry at quiet-before-apply.log:110 reads status "Running" — so foreign_running_transactions is always empty and quiet is always true; this required guard cannot fail and the fragment's quiet-graph evidence is vacuous.

follow-on: the quiet check never subtracts its own SHOW TRANSACTIONS probe, so even with the case corrected it would report itself as a foreign writer; imas_codex/graph/offsite.py:135-163 already owns this probe correctly, identifying its own transaction by currentQuery prefix and raising when it is absent.

blocking: the EXIT= line of every gate log was appended at 02:36:04Z by an inline helper whose exit-code table is the literal {"verify":0,"falsify":0,...} rather than a captured $?, so the log asserts success by assumption; the done_when requires a real EXIT= from a check that raises on mismatch, and a failing run would still read EXIT=0.

follow-on: the header asserts `# revision: f2dfdf83a5c3fe067806224527674c3bbc2ffa10` while the body was produced at 02:31:02Z, before the driver edits at 02:32:19Z-02:34:05Z that moved COHORT_PATH/ANSWERS_PATH out of the repository and added the record mode; the log names a revision that did not produce it.

follow-on: the driver embeds one run's absolute directory path and its run id as source defaults (lines 48-53 and 89-91); the run envelope belongs in the environment, not in a committed evidence file.

follow-on: 19 names are referred to the lead as different-quantity pairs, leaving the plan's other branch for an unchained holder (sn-integrity-backlog §38: "If not, restore the name's own source") unaddressed; the brief redirects those to the lead, so the residue needs a lead decision rather than a node repair.
